description: An expander for Alchemist that gives every one of its sixteen channels a CV input for its fader and an output of its own; it goes immediately to the right of the Alchemist it serves

inputs.text: Shifts that channel's fader on the Alchemist; the voltage is divided by 5 and added to the fader, with the total held between 0% and 200%, so +5V turns the attenuator into a doubling amplifier

outputs.text: That channel's signal after its own fader, the mute and solo logic and Alchemist's master level, as one monophonic signal

notes: The expander does nothing on its own: it has to be immediately to the right of an Alchemist, and the light at its top left comes on when the two are talking.
Every output here saturates rather than clipping once it passes ±10V.
